text: Final categorization: POSSIBLE (Justification: The paper uses LULC prediction as an intermediate step via the LANDSCAPE model to simulate future land use under multiple cropland balance scenarios at national and subnational scales, but its primary objective is assessing impacts on habitat quality—not advancing or focusing on LULC prediction itself. It meets inclusion criteria for national-scale spatial implementation, multiple future scenarios, and quantitative spatial modeling with accuracy metrics (e.g., Kappa Simulation), but LULC prediction serves as input to an ecological assessment using InVEST, making it secondary to the main research goal.)
